_meta.note: Asset-backed proxy registry for the NAV Tracker. Metadata + live-source config only — NO holdings/cost/debt/share figures are stored here; everything financial is fetched live at request time so nothing goes stale.

live_sources.mstr_edgar: MSTR only — dedicated SEC EDGAR 8-K scraper for BTC holdings + avg cost.
live_sources.coingecko: Crypto treasuries — CoinGecko public_treasury API (coin = bitcoin/ethereum); holdings + entry value matched by ticker.
live_sources.sprott: Sprott physical bullion trusts — scrape NAV per unit from the public api-update page (sprott_slug).
live_sources.etf_nav: ETFs that expose navPrice via yfinance (e.g. SLV).

_meta.model: holdings: nav_per_share = (holdings*asset_spot - net_debt)/shares. reported_nav: NAV/unit fetched live, history reconstructed as (nav/current_spot)*asset_spot_series. Debt/cash come live from yfinance totalDebt/totalCash.

CPER.name: United States Copper Index Fund
CPER.note: Futures-based copper index fund (no physical copper trust exists; copper is too bulky to vault). Trades near NAV.

URA.name: Global X Uranium ETF
URA.note: Open-ended uranium-MINERS equity ETF (not physical U3O8); arbitrages to ~NAV so premium/discount stays near zero. asset=self because there is no uranium spot on yfinance. Use a physical-uranium trust with a published NAV feed if you need true U3O8 premium tracking.
